_what_this_is: Published Google Cloud list prices, transcribed from the pages named in source_urls. These are NOT measurements. Nothing in this repository has ever been applied, so no bill exists and no figure here was observed. scripts/cost_model.py multiplies these out against the shape infra/composer.tf declares, and every figure it produces inherits this caveat.
_region_caveat: The pricing pages render a region selector and the price rows are not tagged per region in the page text. Iowa (us-central1) is first in both region lists and these values were read with that default in place, so they are recorded as us-central1 and that attribution is inferred from the page layout rather than stated by it.

composer_generation_2._note: infra/composer.tf declares a google_composer_environment with an explicit workloads_config, which is the Composer 2 shape, so the Gen 2 price list is the one that applies. Gen 3 meters a single DCU hour SKU instead and would need a different model.
